correctness.rationale: From conditional independence P(T>t)=exp(-gt) B_{n,k}(exp(-(e-g)t)). Telescoping uB'_{n,k}=k*binom(n,k)*u^k*(1-u)^(n-k) yields elasticity R(u) strictly decreasing from k to 0 for k<n, and constant n for k=n. For g2>g1, t^-1 log(S_g2/S_g1)=integral_{e-g2}^{e-g1} (R(exp(-st))-1)ds, strictly increasing from -(g2-g1) to (k-1)(g2-g1) for interior k. This proves one crossing, including g2=e boundary; k=1 or k=n has uniform strict sign. Exact n=3,k=2 survival 3exp(-(2e-g)t)-2exp(-(3e-2g)t) integrates to mean (5e-4g)/((2e-g)(3e-2g)); derivative numerator 8x^2-20x+11 gives sole maximum x=(5-sqrt3)/4 and value (8-4sqrt3)/e. Independent exact algebraic binomial derivative and mean check plus inspected uniformization code corroborated; numerical grid alone not proof.
